protocol.funding: All strategies receive the same annual budget on first available NAV date
protocol.cash: Uninvested budgets and cash dividends included, zero interest

protocol.fees: Same static 0.16% purchase fee, FIFO redemption tier as previous study; not historical fees
protocol.lag: Scheduled orders planned independently of NAV; threshold orders lag two NAV observations
protocol.selection: No new parameter tuning; prior selected 40/30 candidate remains exploratory
